description.en: Grimroses are shadow plants that behave like landbound Tangle Kelps, dragging up to 3 zombies into the dirt.
description.zh: 暗樱草是一种暗影植物，她就像是陆地上的缠绕水草，最多可将 3 个僵尸拖入地下。

chat.en: "When you think about it, the proper place for a zombie is in the ground," says Grimrose. "So, really, I'm just expediting the process."
chat.zh: “仔细想想，僵尸本就该待在地里，”暗樱草说， “所以实际上，我只是在加速这个过程罢了。”

text.en: powered Grimroses can drag 3 zombies before expiring
text.zh: 得到暗影能量时才能发挥拖下 3 只僵尸的能力
